reason: This replaces a minified vue-multiselect bundle with an unminified but functionally equivalent version and removes an unrelated stray popper.js copy asset, so behavior should be unchanged but the large diff makes visual review of actual semantic equivalence hard and any subtle transcription error would affect all admin UI multiselect widgets across tenants.
